text:
The ultrasound findings of a well-circumscribed subcutaneous cystic lesion on the nape of the neck, combined with the patient's history of golf (potential repetitive minor trauma) and lack of systemic symptoms, strongly suggest a benign cystic structure. Given the location and imaging characteristics, an epidermoid cyst or a ganglion cyst are the most likely differentials, but the "cystic nature" in subcutaneous tissue is classic for an epidermal inclusion cyst.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Epidermoid Cyst
